subject: addObserver:forKeyPath:options:context:

observation.summary: Runtime probe iterates class_copyMethodList() on NSObject and observes the standard KVO API surface as instance methods: addObserver:forKeyPath:options:context:, removeObserver:forKeyPath:, removeObserver:forKeyPath:context:, observeValueForKeyPath:ofObject:change:context: plus private helpers _addObserver:forProperty:options:context: / _removeObserver:forProperty:. NSArray additionally exposes the to-many variants addObserver:toObjectsAtIndexes:forKeyPath:options:context: and removeObserver:fromObjectsAtIndexes:forKeyPath:.

claim: NSObject is the KVO root class and exports -addObserver:forKeyPath:options:context: plus the matching -removeObserver / -observeValueForKeyPath:ofObject:change:context: API surface as public instance methods (the private _addObserver:forProperty:_ helpers are also visible via class_copyMethodList but are documented as private).

cross_reference.label: Swift reimplementation does NOT implement KVO at all (no addObserver: implementation; the project README acknowledges this)
